title: Show a splashscreen while the app performs setup

steps.task: Install the frontend dependencies and confirm the scaffold builds and answers over IPC before changing anything.

Register the windows in `tauri.conf.json`: a window labeled `main` created hidden, and a window labeled `splashscreen` shown directly, loading the `/splashscreen` URL. Leave the other options at their defaults.

Create a `/splashscreen` page for the splashscreen window to load: a `splashscreen.html` next to `index.html`, and whatever build configuration is needed for `pnpm build` to emit it into `dist/` — the production app must be able to load it, not only the dev server.

steps.task: Fake a heavy setup task on each side: a `setTimeout`-based task in the frontend and a Tokio sleep in the backend. Track both in a shared `SetupState` behind a `set_complete` command; when both sides report done, close the splashscreen window and show the main window.
